abort_conditions: the contract is not FROZEN before final execution
a final seed is used for implementation, smoke testing, threshold selection, or parameter selection
the evaluation metric changes after final outputs are inspected
the target receives the held-out stress location, held-out family label, or future outcome
the total interaction-weight budget changes during adaptation
a positive classification requires dropping a scheduled stress family, severity, size, seed, or control
the static-hardened reference is presented as a causal adaptation control
a toy internal result is promoted to general, physical, biological, economic, or engineering antifragility
claim_ceiling: Bounded toy evidence that a stress-triggered, budget-conserving graph update improves later held-out recoverability under the frozen finite schedule.

positive_classification_requires: the paired target-minus-passive seed-block confidence interval lower bound is at least 0.15
the paired target-minus-random and target-minus-reversed confidence interval lower bounds exceed zero
every held-out stress family has median target gain at least 0.10
the tenth percentile target gain is at least 0.10 and no target row regresses against its passive pair
target gain is nondecreasing with exposure severity
the sham condition produces no adaptation gain
interaction-weight budget error is at most 1e-12
operator identity cosine is at least 0.95 and primary capacity retention is at least 0.75
target collapse is never earlier than passive collapse and shifts later in at least one primary-stress group
all exposure and held-out primary damage locations are disjoint
all scheduled rows and controls are present and the semantic checker passes

exposure.observable: maximum fractional loss among currently available primary interactions

graph_family.interaction_weight_budget: one unit per node, invariant across every pre-test adapted graph

mechanism.persistent_update: uniformly transfer interaction-weight budget from primary ring edges to local distance-two backup edges

operational_definition.antifragility_gain: held-out recovery capacity after stress-triggered update minus held-out recovery capacity before update under the identical test perturbation
operational_definition.interaction_invariant: the graph family, total weight budget, stress schedule, recovery-capacity formula, identity metric, thresholds, and controls remain frozen
operational_definition.recovery_capacity: harmonic mean of algebraic-connectivity ratio and effective-conductance ratio relative to the unexposed baseline graph
operational_definition.strict_hierarchy: robustness and recoverability do not imply antifragility; positive held-out change caused by prior stress is additionally required

smoke_partition.access_policy: implementation and deterministic smoke tests only; never contributes evidence or thresholds
